title: GFG: Mirror Inversion of Binary Tree
description: Given a binary tree represented as a level-order array of nodes, create its mirror image (invert left and right subtrees) and return the resulting level-order array.
solution:
def mirror_tree(nodes: list) -> list:
    if not nodes:
        return []
    # In a full binary tree level order, each level is reversed
    res = []
    idx = 0
    level_size = 1
    while idx < len(nodes):
        level = nodes[idx:idx + level_size]
        res.extend(reversed(level))
        idx += level_size
        level_size *= 2
    return res
explanation: Mirroring a binary tree reverses each horizontal depth level in O(N) time.
